correctness.rationale: Generator moment closure follows from finite-state local flip rules. Unique stationary distribution for finite positive bath temperatures. Exact heat current and ratio are obtained by rational elimination. Positive denominator and two exact derivatives yield strict all-temperature ratio and unattained sharp supremum; two-spin baseline follows separately. 200 exact-rational tests of full Markov generators supplement the proof.

value.rationale: The precise question of whether coupling two baths to inequivalent coordination sites rectifies heat despite equal bonds and equal attempt rates is a natural finite-system thermal-transport boundary. Exact all-temperature response, the unexpectedly above-two sharp amplification limit and minimum size offer independently useful quantitative benchmarks. This is not merely a known-table recomputation or parameter relabeling.
